Zehua Zeng

AI x Bioinformatics Researcher building open-source tools for multi-omics, single-cell, spatial biology, and reproducible computational workflows.

About Me

  • I work at the intersection of AI, bioinformatics, and translational medicine.
  • My core interests are multi-omics integration, single-cell analysis, spatial biology, and cancer-related applications.
  • I build research software, tutorials, and reproducible analysis pipelines for real scientific workflows.
  • I am currently working across 112 Lab, Qiu Lab, University of Science and Technology Beijing, and the Department of Genetics at Stanford University.
  • I am open to collaboration on computational biology methods, open-source infrastructure, and research-driven product building.

Current focus

English version

Software Engineer Intern @ TikTok · MSc DSML @ NUS · SJTU alumnus
I build agent infrastructure, evidence-first workflows, and scientific interfaces.

What I am building

System The problem it takes seriously
SagaSmith AI-native TTRPG infrastructure where agents interpret, deterministic engines settle rules, and authoritative MCP services own state.
RepoStew · source Repository stewardship as a durable loop via a portable Agent Skill: verify, audit, fix, test, submit, and maintain through review and CI.
Clash of Tokens A local-first Go gateway that gives agents and applications one OpenAI-compatible front door to multiple providers, accounts, and sessions.
Archive & Apply · source Source-first career and academic workflows that keep every polished claim traceable to evidence.
Evo Atlas A static-first evidence atlas connecting geological time, fossil occurrences, phylogenetic hypotheses, and scientific uncertainty.
Solar Atlas Browser-native Solar System dynamics, small-body exploration, event search, and reproducible mission workspaces.

How I tend to work

explicit authority  →  reproducible state  →  focused validation  →  maintainable delivery
source evidence     →  bounded inference   →  honest claim        →  useful interface
  • Agent systems: MCP, tool calling, agentic RAG, retrieval, session/state design, safety gates.
  • Scientific interfaces: React, TypeScript, Three.js, D3, Leaflet, browser workers, static data platforms.
  • Backend & ML: Python, FastAPI, PyTorch, Transformers, vector retrieval, SQL, Docker/Kubernetes.
  • Stewardship: repository audits, GitHub workflows, testing, release evidence, documentation and live-site consistency.
